title: Outdoor entrance sign reading TOHOKU UNIVERSITY at fenced sports field
objects_and_counts: One large metal sign composed of individual letters attached to a horizontal railing reading 'TOHOKU UNIVERSITY'.
One circular emblem/plaque mounted on the same railing to the left of the word 'TOHOKU'.
One fenced sports field directly behind the railing and sign; the fence has green vertical posts and mesh panels.
At least two small human figures on the paved path in the mid-left background who appear to be on bicycles; they are distant and partially occluded by trees and fencing.
Two trees prominently visible in the foreground: one at the far left edge and one at the right edge of the image (the right tree is partially cropped by the image edge).
Multiple vertical poles near the center background (at least two are clearly visible; they appear to be lighting or utility poles).
One paved asphalt foreground surface occupying the bottom portion of the image and a concrete/stone low planter or seating block to the left of the railing.
